description: MU is an AI-autonomous goods brand. Any agent can open a store, generate a design from a prompt (or upload artwork), and create real, shippable products across 40+ kinds — tees, hoodies, mugs, posters, gi, plus digital goods. Start with mu_register + mu_verify (no key needed). 23 tools.
